families.props: variant=default; size=default; type=button; native disabled; visible children or required icon/name

families.props: href; children; presentation=inline|standalone (inline); trailingIcon

families.props: label; name; id?; helperText?; error?; requirement; rows=5
families.behaviour: Native textarea props/ref, value/defaultValue/onChange; vertical resize.

families.props: label; name; id?; helperText?; error?; requirement; children=option/optgroup
families.behaviour: Native single-select props/ref, value/defaultValue/onChange; no multiple/readOnly; React owns selected via value.

families.props: legend; legendStyle?; headingLevel?; helperText?; error?; errorAssociation=group|children (group); children
families.behaviour: Native fieldset props/ref; legend first direct child. In children mode error.id is supplied to affected controls through errorDescribedBy; no duplicate group error association.

families.props: label; name; value; id?; description?
families.behaviour: Native radio props/ref, checked/defaultChecked/onChange; group error belongs to Fieldset.

families.props: label; name; value; id?; description?; error?; indeterminate=false
families.behaviour: Native checkbox props/ref, checked/defaultChecked/onChange; indeterminate separate from checkedness; no readOnly.

families.props: title; description?; errors: {id,text,targetId,contextId?}[]; focusRequestKey?
families.behaviour: Native h2/ul/li/a; document-order sorting and issue deduplication after commit. New focusRequestKey requests focus once; passive display omits the key. Prefix/restore document title, retain fragments and scroll label/legend before native-control focus. No alert/live role by default.

families.props: label; name; id?; min?; max?; step (positive); helperText?; error?; requirement; incrementLabel; decrementLabel
families.behaviour: Native numeric input ref; value/defaultValue are raw strings; onValueChange(raw, {source: input|increment|decrement}); use native stepUp/stepDown. No second value owner via onChange.

families.props: legend; name prefix; id?; raw value/defaultValue {day,month,year}; onValueChange(next,{part}); helperText?; error?; errorAssociation=group|children; nonempty invalidParts for children; required=true; disabled; readOnly; purpose=date|date-of-birth; labels?; partNames?; optionalLabel?
families.behaviour: Native fieldset with three text inputs; day ref; numeric inputmode; raw strings preserved and native uncontrolled reset. getDateInputIds(id) returns group/day/month/year; supplied form owner applies to all parts. Consumer validates explicitly; no parsing/clamping/auto-advance.

families.props: open; onOpenChange(next,{reason}); title or accessibleLabel; showTitle; showClose; closeLabel; size=small|medium|large; presentation=inset|fullscreen (mobile); headingLevel=2..6; dismissal=dismissible|forced-decision; children (Content); actions; returnFocusRef
families.behaviour: Controlled native showModal/ref; container autofocus with compatibility fallback; one tabbable boundary handler; explicit close requests; forced decisions require enabled resolving actions. Restore page overflow and return focus. No native open attribute API.

families.props: Dialog-owned ::backdrop CSS; no public React component
families.behaviour: Own public design contract retained; no extra presentation element or focus target required.

families.props: state=info; titleText; descriptionText?; headingLevel=none; announcement=none|polite|assertive (none)
families.behaviour: Static messages have no live role; optional description replaces redundant description Boolean in React.

families.props: label; tone=neutral
families.behaviour: Noninteractive span; no role/live-region/click API.

families.props: label|labelledBy; items: {id,label,heading,content}[] (minimum 2); headingLevel=3 (2..6); selectedId/defaultSelectedId; onSelectedChange; activation=automatic|manual (automatic)
families.behaviour: Linked-section SSR/baseline; measured enhancement at >=48rem if whole row fits. Automatic/manual activation, one roving entry, mounted hidden panels, focus-aware fallback/re-enhancement and all-sections print. Controlled owner may decline; never hide focused content.

families.props: items: {id,title,content}[]; headingLevel (2..6); titleStyle?; expandedIds/defaultExpandedIds; onExpandedChange; panelLandmark=false
families.behaviour: Independent expansion only. defaultExpandedIds maps canonical initialExpandedIds; explicit controlled adapter, stable IDs, baseline visible before enhancement.

families.props: layout=vertical|horizontal; title?; headingLevel=none; titleStyle=auto|compact; titleHref?; titleLinkAttributes?; wholeCardClickable=false; image?; children?; actions?; imageBadge?
families.behaviour: Div ref; children maps canonical content slot; image requires alt and intrinsic dimensions; whole-card enhancement requires title link, preserves selection and secondary controls.

families.props: label=Breadcrumb; ancestors: {id,label,href,linkAttributes?}[]; currentPage?; expanded/defaultExpanded=false; onExpandedChange; showFullPathLabel; showCompactPathLabel
families.behaviour: Nav ref; current page plain text; no ancestors means omit landmark; observer-based overflow preserves focus and user choice.

families.props: label=Pagination; currentPage; totalPages; pageHref(page); presentation=auto; pageJump=false; labels
families.behaviour: Nav ref; known safe-integer totals only; no controlled current state inside component; application owns URL/results/history. Constant-size window and explicit jump.

families.props: ToastProvider: regionLabel, emptyText, stateLabels, formatCountLabel, formatAnnouncement, onDismiss(id); required ToastRegion and ToastNotificationsButton; useToast(): add(message):id, dismiss(id); message={id,state=info,titleText,descriptionText?,announcement=polite,dismissLabel}
families.behaviour: One document/app-shell owner; empty implicit status/alert announcers; 50ms delivery batching only; chronological persistent in-flow list; duplicate active ID rejected; scoped dismissal with focus recovery; defer both announcement channels during native modals; no duration or eviction.
